contradictions.what: Rep thought the load test had won it, but Halima's only reaction was good and it did not move her.
Rep says we were the favourite and Ben told his team to plan the integration, yet Halima was the decider and Ben lost.
Rep calls us the better platform, but the decider said she buys what happens when it's down, not uptime.
Rep says the competitor over-promised, then admits not knowing; the claim itself came from Ben.

Customer was replacing payments before spring on-sales; no sign that only part of the business moved.
